sections.label: O Organizaci
sections.holds: Co Organizace dělá, pro koho, jak vydělává a čím se řídí.

sections.label: Lidé a role
sections.holds: Kdo za co odpovídá, kdo koho zastupuje a na koho se s čím obrátit.

sections.label: Procesy a postupy
sections.holds: Jak se opakovaná práce dělá krok za krokem, pro lidi.

sections.label: Postupy pro agenty
sections.holds: Jak má agent opakovanou práci udělat, co smí sám a kde se zastaví.

sections.label: Slovník
sections.holds: Pojmy Organizace, jedna stránka na pojem, s jinými názvy a s tím, s čím si ho neplést.

sections.label: Rozhodnutí
sections.holds: Co se rozhodlo, kdo a kdy rozhodl, proč a co z toho plyne.

sections.label: About the Organization
sections.holds: What the Organization does, for whom, how it earns its living and what guides its decisions.

sections.label: People and roles
sections.holds: Who is responsible for what, who stands in for whom, and whom to ask about what.

sections.label: Processes and procedures
sections.holds: How repeated work is done step by step, for people.

sections.label: Procedures for agents
sections.holds: How an agent does repeated work, what it may do on its own and where it stops.

sections.label: Glossary
sections.holds: The Organization's terms, one page per term, with their other names and what not to confuse them with.

sections.label: Decisions
sections.holds: What was decided, who decided and when, why, and what follows from it.
